Position: MBD-ASW Developer<

Location: Pune<

Experience: 2 – 8 Years<

Open Positions: 25<

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days<

Job Overview:<

We are looking for an MBD Software Developer with strong experience in MATLAB/Simulink and AUTOSAR (CSAR) application layer modeling. The role involves model-based development, testing, and validation in the automotive powertrain domain.<

<

Mandatory Skills:< <

  • MATLAB / Simulink / Stateflow<
  • AUTOSAR Application Layer (CSAR)<
  • MATLAB scripting<
  • MIL, SIL, HIL Testing<
  • Polyspace, Calterm<
  • OBD, Aftertreatment Controls< <

    <

    Key Responsibilities:< <

  • Model-based development using MATLAB/Simulink<
  • AUTOSAR CSAR layer modeling and development<
  • Perform MIL, SIL, and HIL testing<
  • Algorithm development (filters, lookup tables, PI controllers, timers)<
  • Unit Testing and Integration Testing<
  • Auto code generation and build process<
  • Debugging and problem-solving<
  • Testing on open loop test benches< <

    <

    Additional Skills:< <

  • Experience with Calterm and Polyspace<
  • Windchill and ClearCase understanding<
  • Requirements management knowledge<
  • Knowledge of Fuel Systems, Air Handling Systems<
  • Experience in Cruise Control / ADAS domain<
  • Automotive Powertrain experience< <

    Education:<

    BTech / BE / MTech / MS in Electronics & Telecommunication (ENTC)<

    Interview Drive Details:<

    Date: 27 June<

    Location: Pune (Face-to-Face)<

    Time: 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM< <

  • Face-to-face interviews will be conducted on 27 June between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM.
  • Screening will be conducted by the panel before scheduling confirmation with the candidate. Only shortlisted candidates will be considered for lineup.
  • Only candidates with immediate to 30 days' notice period are eligible.
  • Only Face-to-Face candidates will be considered.

    • To Apply:

    While applying, kindly mention the Job Title in the email subject line

    Share your updated resume at Shital.jakkulwar@tatatechnologies.com

    • Total Experience
    • Relevant Experience
    • Current Company
    • Current Location
    • Preferred Location
    • Current CTC
    • Expected CTC
    • Notice Period / Last Working Day
    • Any Career Gap (if applicable)
